Author: @nolanrex00
Content:
Mark you will love "Still Lies The Deep." It's a beautiful horror game about the sea but also human resilience. It does take some skill, but with your FNAF background you'll have fun getting through all the areas and different monsters. 

Everyone I've seen play this game has loved it and said it has stuck with them. The last game I've seen make this much of an impact on the Internet was Mouthwashing. 

This games is a piece of art made with so much authenticity and passion, I promise this one will stay with you. It's a love letter to the hundreds of people who lived that reality. It's a snap shot of a time and place in history important to it's country, yet not as well know I'm other West countries. It's still relevant today. 

It already has a DLC that creators are playing and playing and posting  videos of. 

I know you don't have a lot of free time and you have a list of games to play, but even if you play it just for yourself, I think it's worth it.

 In today's Distractible episode you guys talked about how shit big game companies are now and how embarrassing their releases are. You talked about how indie games or games made by small teams are monumentally overwhelming triple A games, and of these Still Wakes The Deep is one of the best.

It's epic. It's so gorgeous and memorable. I compare it to Death Stranding when it first came out and we were all shocked at how amazing it looked. 

Maybe I'm exaggerating a bit, but I champion this game because I believe it's a Beacon demanding upon others to rise up. To create other monumental, titan games to stand above, upholding the only standard of games we will accept. To stand above the thick, disgusting smog these big companies ooze and fester in, while  gathering their filth to craft their shit games. 

Happy birthday Mark, and gift yourself grace and happiness. Play if you are happy, and play what will make you happy.
